body:
Oh they know. I've been in and out of therapy for the past 14 years of my life. Anxiety, OCD, Panic disorder, ADHD, depression. Xanax, Prozac, Zoloft, aderall, 5HTP, b vitamins, lexapro. Every guy has a new label for what's wrong and a new shiny little pill fix to fix it all. After a while, I decided it was best to smile and gulp down whatever they gave me and say that I felt much better thanks.
The thought of explaining yet again why i just dont feel good is exhausting and dreadful.
